note: The passenger doors of each aircraft model (to-do 212): in the model's own cm - x its right, y aft, z up, the root at the nose wheel on the ground. box: the model's bounds when the doors were measured; the game measures the model that really stands there and moves the doors with it, so a rescaled model needs no change here (measure again only when its shape changes). skin: the middle of the sill on the skin; turn: degrees the skin there is turned from straight out.
